event_text: PLAID detects the unauthorised access, which began in the early hours, and starts stopping all KARTE services
notes: Time from PLAID's Nov 16 notice. That is 6:59 PM Eastern on Thu Nov 12.

event_text: PLAID tells ZOZO; ZOZO stops its data link to KARTE
PLAID's investigation finds that data ZOZO managed on KARTE had leaked
PLAID publishes its first notice confirming that data leaked, and that the attacker took credentials
JINS and RIZAP publish their own notices: up to about 18.29 million JINS member accounts and up to about 4.32 million RIZAP emails affected
notes: Date only, from the two companies' notices.

event_text: MUFG Bank publishes its own notice: about 6.5 million records of customers' gender, age and region leaked through KARTE
notes: Date only, from the bank's notice.

event_text: ZOZO publishes its notice with the counts; PLAID publishes its investigation results and a mid-January restart target
Shimamura publishes its first report: birth dates, gender, prefecture and postal code of about 7 million members leaked through KARTE
notes: Date only, from the company's notice.

event_text: DHC publishes its notice: about 19.11 million customer records, including names and emails, leaked through KARTE
notes: Date only, from the company's notice.
